correctness.rationale: For G=w²+wq+b in characteristic 2, G_w=q and G_{y_i}=wq_{y_i}+b_{y_i}. Direct substitution confirms the listed representative and its two incident companion curves lie in the Jacobian singular set. Normal expansion along the curve L yields Q_t=w²+w((t+1)x0+x1+t x2)+(t+1)x0x1; independently differentiated its polar matrix and computed determinant t²(t+1)². Thus for finite t≠0,1 its polar form is nondegenerate; at t=0 Q_0=(w+x0)(w+x1). The third special point t=∞ and all fifteen curves follow from the cited S6 geometry. This proves local normal-tangent statements along the specified stratum, NOT exhaustion of the global singular scheme.
